name: cgp-follow-ups
description: Keeps the follow-up issues of your session in view: every issue Claude creates in Jira, GitHub or Linear is tracked, its status follows the tracker by itself, and a row in the CGP bar shows what is still open. By Crypto Gameplan.

syncEvery.title: Sync every
syncEvery.description: How often open follow-ups are read back from Jira, GitHub or Linear. They are also read right after Claude creates or changes one, when you send a prompt, and when you open the panel.

bar.title: Bar above the prompt
bar.description: on: a row shows the open follow-ups while there are any (inside the CGP Effort bar when that is installed). off: only the panel and /cgp-follow-ups.
